content:
Rocco now has Scene.environment for setting the sky, the clear colour, the tone map, the exposure, fog and bloom.

https://github.com/Pixelsprout/rocco-engine/releases/tag/v0.10.0
@pixelsprout Do you have more example images anywhere? The image you just posted looks really nice!

@Steve Howell I'm working on a more detailed scene at the moment which has more detail. Includes ambient occlusion, batched draw calls, particle emitter, volumetric fog and more...

I'll probably do a blog post once I have worked through some benchmarks and testing.

By the way, I am cribbing a couple ideas from your tutorial for a tutorial that I am writing:

  • ending each chapter on what's still missing
  • opening with a short list of what's new
  • giving each interactive widget an instruction and a predicted result
  • a page of surprises

I particularly like the "surprises".
